title: D3.js Small Examples
description: Use these small D3.js examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Select and append an SVG shape
examples.description: A D3 selection points to page elements. append creates a child element, and attr sets one of its attributes.
examples.output: A navy circle appears at x=80, y=80 with radius 30.

examples.title: Put data into a join
examples.description: A data join matches data values to elements.

examples.title: Map numbers to positions
examples.description: A linear scale maps one number range to another.
examples.output: The value 50 maps to the middle of the drawing range, x=160.

examples.title: Give categories equal spaces
examples.description: A band scale gives named categories separate spaces.
examples.output: Three equal-width bars occupy the weekday bands with gaps.

examples.title: Draw bars from values
examples.description: A bar chart uses height to show a number.
examples.output: The bars grow upward from y=180 for values 30, 60 and 90.

examples.title: Add readable labels
examples.description: Text labels tell readers what a chart value means.
examples.output: The chart shows 3 books, 6 books and 9 books at separate positions.

examples.title: Draw an axis
examples.description: An axis draws ticks and labels for a scale.
examples.output: A horizontal number axis appears near the bottom of the SVG.

examples.title: Connect points with a line
examples.description: A line generator turns a list of points into an SVG path.
examples.output: A navy line connects the four points in their list order.

examples.title: Make a small pie layout
examples.description: A pie layout turns values into angles. An arc generator uses those angles to draw slice paths.
examples.output: The circle is divided into shares of 20%, 30% and 50%.

examples.title: Update an existing join
examples.description: Calling a join again with new data updates the matching elements.
examples.output: The final chart has two circles with radii 15 and 25. The third old circle is removed.

examples.title: React to a chart event
examples.description: D3 can attach an event handler to a shape.
examples.output: Clicking a circle logs its own book count.

examples.title: Give the chart a text explanation
examples.description: A visual chart should have a useful name and a text explanation.
examples.output: The SVG has an accessible title and description as well as visible summary text.
